trends.what: A curated, community-maintained list of free public APIs for developers to use in their projects.
trends.why: It's the go-to reference for developers looking to quickly find free data sources, making it a timeless and highly-starred resource.

trends.what: An open-source platform offering a full curriculum and interactive coding challenges to learn programming, math, and computer science for free.
trends.why: It's a massive, self-paced learning hub that democratizes tech education, consistently attracting learners and contributors worldwide.

trends.what: A comprehensive repository of freely available programming books, tutorials, and learning resources in multiple languages.
trends.why: It serves as a free library for developers at all levels, making it a staple bookmark for anyone seeking cost-free technical knowledge.

trends.what: A personal AI assistant that runs on any OS and platform, designed to be your always-available digital helper.
trends.why: Its cross-platform flexibility and 'lobster way' branding make it a fun, accessible entry point for users wanting their own AI sidekick.

trends.what: Interactive roadmaps, guides, and educational content that help developers plan and grow their careers step-by-step.
trends.why: It turns the chaotic path of tech learning into clear visual paths, which is essential for both beginners and career-changers.

trends.what: A tool that makes AI agents write code in the style of a lazy senior developer, prioritizing minimal and simple solutions.
trends.why: It's a humorous yet practical take on AI code generation, appealing to devs who value clean, over-engineered-free code.

trends.what: A fullscreen, mouse-interactive coding agent harness and terminal UI (TUI) for building with AI assistance.
trends.why: It offers a novel, immersive way to interact with coding agents, pushing the boundaries of developer tooling UX.

trends.what: A pure C, zero-dependency runtime that runs frontier mixture-of-experts (MoE) models on local hardware by streaming experts from disk.
trends.why: It makes high-end AI models accessible on everyday machines, a breakthrough for privacy and cost-conscious users.
